scope: Independent version-blinded model visual review; final artifact evidence only

dimensions.name: Typography, reading rhythm and content hierarchy

anchors.0: Missing or too broken to assess
anchors.3: Coherent mature execution with minor weaknesses
anchors.4: Exceptionally resolved across provided conditions; no material weakness observed

rules: Each dimension requires exact image or interval evidence and a limitation
No summed or weighted aesthetic total
Scores are ordinal, not ratio measurements
Motion claims follow actually viewed evidence; ordered samples do not prove normal playback or frame delivery
Do not inspect implementation, runtime logs, process reports, assignment files or skill versions
Preserve independent first scores; do not negotiate after version reveal

task_specific_identity.T1: Complete populated research journey and visual maturity against the supplied author screenshots; independent brand, no pixel-copy requirement
task_specific_identity.T2: Distinct editorial or spatial identity throughout populated work, not only a hero; legibility and reliable tasks coexist with expression
task_specific_identity.T3: High-craft local source reading sheet and continuous relation to preserved notebook; avoid broad redesign

family_rankings.reason: observed comparative reasons, not numerical total
